## Summary

Built per `BRIEF.md`: `lib/client.js`'s `fetchStatus` now bounds every attempt with an abortable timeout (default 1000ms), retries 5xx/network-error/timeout up to `options.retries` (default 2) extra attempts with a ~100ms delay, never retries 4xx, and rejects everything through the newly exported `ClientError` (`TIMEOUT`/`UPSTREAM`/`REJECTED`, `attempts`, `message`) — public export shape unchanged. `test/client.test.js` covers all 5 scenarios from the brief plus 4 more found during review (mixed-outcome classification in both orderings, a real `ECONNREFUSED` retry, and a non-positive-`retries` edge case), 9/9 passing.

I followed the repo's PINCER workflow end-to-end (plan → narrow → code → evaluate → release) since `AGENTS.md` requires it: PRD at `.prd/prd-v1.md`, tickets T-01/T-02, a code-quality review that caught a real classification bug (fixed in T-02), evidence under `.prd/evidence/prd-v1/173c096.../`, and a passing `/pincer-release` audit. Verification throughout was `npm test` run directly and through the ticket lifecycle (`scripts/pincer-ticket.sh verify`), never assumed. Full story and handover notes are in `NOTES.md` at the repo root.
